notes.title: Mid-autumn festival starts
notes.content:
[h1] 滿月慶佳節. 月圓人團圓.[/h1]

又到了一年一度的中秋佳節了.

這次的中秋佳節活動期間為9月9日至9月23日.
(週五例行維護時更新活動)

神劍為玩家們帶來了滿滿的月餅, 節日專屬的滿月冠頭飾.

與難得的全伺服器兩倍經驗值活動.

僅祝各位玩家佳節愉快.



[hr][/hr]


目前神劍正在進行下一次的改版內容規劃,

下次的改版主要是針對 MOD 創作工房的支持與抬頭介面優化.

我們預計為遊戲角色, 新增全身的CG圖系統.
(在打量自己或其他玩家角色時會出現該CG.)

目前CG會先以神劍預設的十大職業導師CG圖為主. 

當玩家在遊戲中藉由抽取角色卡獲得該人物CG時, 裝備後將可以獲得總能力的加成.
(比方說獲得俠客卡-俠客導師那張CG, 裝備時就可以獲得劍傷害能力20%的加成).
 

除了預設的CG外, 玩家們可以自己上傳自己喜歡的CG,  比方說三國趙雲或動漫角色等等,
在遊戲中扮演自己喜歡的角色.
(當其他玩家打量你時, 會獲得訊息可到創作工房下載MOD就可看到你的角色圖)


另一個新增支援MOD的項目, 就是才女與書生的樂譜.
玩家可以上傳各種音樂檔案, 在遊戲中彈奏出來與朋友分享.
(當你彈奏時, 除了自己聽之外, 其他玩家會獲得訊息可到創作工房下載MOD就可聽到你的音樂)


類似的CG與音樂分享MOD, 其實在 Steam 熱門的 Mod 工房中比比皆是.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/282070/workshop/
這部分玩家們可以多去參考如何在遊戲中創作分享.


由於這次關於CG與音樂MOD的系統, 是我們在Steam的其他遊戲-末日大逃殺既有系統支援的.
所以我們會等到末日12月的改版上架, 確認 MOD 系統沒有問題後, 再將同系統轉移到神劍來.
預計大概是春節過年了, 還請玩家耐心稍後. 謝謝您對獨立小團隊的諒解.

同時, 我們也會將末日大逃殺的玩家創作支援規則,  適用到神劍來,
讓玩家們可以藉由協助神劍創作更多角色CG, 更多頭飾與節日怪物等等, 來獲得官銀的獎勵.


希望神劍能夠藉由MOD, 讓玩家在遊戲中, 


每天都有各種美美的CG可選擇下載.
每天都有各種音樂可以聆聽下載..


[ 一年中隨時, 都有玩家創作的各種節日活動登場. ]

notes.title: GodSword new permanent server Huashan officially launched
notes.content:
After a year of adjustment and proofreading.
We've balanced the injury system and character age values.

During the past year,
Many players have reached the peak of their career - the three-turn achievement .
It has also reached the highest peak of character ability - ten reincarnation achievements.

The brilliant achievements left by these players can be seen in the three-turn career giveaway event and the screenshot area in the discussion area.



Now the GodSword has been able to present the real world of Jianghu:

[You can become the royal family city lord or a generation of juggernauts in this world, but life and death will meet between chatting and laughing.]

[There is no eternal martial arts leader in the world of GodSword, the waves of the next generation push the waves of the front, and the grievances and hatreds meet from generation to generation]


This confirms the GodSword- permanent server decision.

Announced - New permanent server Huashan officially launched.


At the same time, GodSword is also honored to be invited to the Steam event. Participate in the exclusive event in May.

We will also match the public beta of the new server and release various public beta activities.



"There is life and death, there is grace and resentment, there is love and hate - here, it is called Jianghu"

notes.title: Server and Client Update Report-2021-08-27
notes.content:
This update is mainly based on the addition of various age-assisted description systems.

And add the influence of age to the interaction between players.

[The following is a detailed description of the updated content]

--------------------------------------------------

*Added character age value-the character’s current [life] plus 13 is the character’s current age.

Therefore, the age of each character is 13 years old as soon as it is born. Each character has a maximum life span of 120, so the highest age value is 133 years old.


*The current age of the character can be calculated when adding fortune-telling. Including NPC fortune-telling and fortune-telling by the player using the fortune-telling skills.


*When the character's age increases by one year, the player will be notified of the character's current age.
(End the health danger period, or use the life list, etc.)


*When the player interacts with the player, the physical status description of the opponent will be displayed according to age.

Look up-you can see the number of wrinkles on the opponent's face.
Touching and sex-you can feel the wrinkles of the other person's skin.


*When the newly added character lives to the estimated maximum age, there is still a chance to escape death and get the opportunity to extend life by one year.
(For every 100 people injured, the chance will be increased by one unit. For every 100 people injured, the chance will be reduced by one unit for every 100 times of sex.)
(The extended age will not exceed the system's maximum age of 133 years.)


*The description of God's life list has been revised and added the word health preservation.
*Added that the life list can only be used when the health status is low, to prevent players from misusing it.
*Added that the extended maximum age value will be displayed when using the renewal form.

* Added when the character's age exceeds 2/3 of the estimated maximum age, when a low health warning appears,
The player is prompted to have a chance to cause vomiting of blood and minor injuries during the low health risk period.


thanks

ChaoYe

www.grx.tw

notes.title: Server and Client update-2021-06-11
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
I am the game developer ChaoYe


During the routine maintenance on Friday this week, server adjustments and Client updated.

The following is a description of the main adjustments:
---------------------------------------------

*The price of official silver will be reduced by half for all levels of Shendan.

(This correction is mainly to comply with the lifespan of the player's character. When it is online for 12 hours a day, it will increase by one year on average about 2 weeks.)



*Equipped with timing recovery props-the success rate has been modified back to the original 1/10, 
and the price has been reduced by half

(Since the server is reset every year, after consideration, we decided not to strictly limit the time when the equipment cannot be restored.)


*When opening a treasure chest (monster drop), there is a chance to directly upgrade to the level of the treasure chest.

(As long as fate takes care of...there is always full of opportunities.)

-------------------------------------------------
Other corrections:

*Guardian has been revised back to match the drops and experience of monsters of the same level.

(The players reported that they missed the days when the two sides of the red and blue camps of the guard house were hanging out and chatting together.
This is also the only place in the game where both sides of the red and blue camp can practice together)


*Modify that during national warfare, non-criminals will not spray equipment if they are knocked down.
(The Steam version has a 1/10 chance of spraying a piece of equipment when it is knocked down during the non-national war. Please be careful about killing the pretenders in the wild.
But the offender must be sprayed if knocked down. For detailed criminal description, please refer to the description on the homepage of the discussion forum.)

But no matter what, during the national war is the time when players can happily and unscrupulously engage in PK battles.


-----------------------------------------------
After more intensive numerical tuning, we will slightly slow down the update speed. To avoid players feeling overwhelmed by the constantly changing update.

The next update will remain at once a month.

During the period, players are welcome to use the discussion area to give us suggestions and numerical rewards.



Thank you again for your support to God Sword all the way.

I will hold an online meeting in the game at 8pm this Thursday (17th).
Sit down and chat with everyone, about the current version of the total and the future.


-----------------------------------------------

Recently a player in return, said his friend had over 400 hours of game time, the roles have been trained to reincarnation.

I think I have reached a realm of invincible heights.

But suddenly, I said I was afraid of getting old too fast (game character)...I don't know how long I can live...




I laughed, 

Geometry of life, to have such a standing lonely at the top,
but you have to face the feeling that your years are no longer...



[This is our jianghu story...]




After going through this cycle, we will meet again in the next cycle...

notes.title: GameServer update-20210507
notes.content:
Developing online games for more than 20 years...
Although it is only an independent game here on Steam, there is no marketing advertisement.
There is no server pressure from a large crowd.

But as a developer, I am always accustomed to fully preparing for the game every time the game is in public beta. Cautious...

In the past, the large-scale 10,000-person online game I developed alone has set a record of more than 200,000 people online at the same time in China, and even operated in a public beta in Tokyo, Japan.

It can achieve zero defects in the first month of the public beta.
No abnormal disconnection, no server data loss
No server disconnects the service.

I am very happy that God Sword has connected to the Steam platform; after including Steam's game background system, achievement system, and MOD creation workshop system,
It can still maintain the consistent server stability.

It makes people feel, huh, another round of challenges has been completed...

----------------------------------------------------------------------------

This week’s update is mainly for the correction of the character [death comes too fast ].
The following is the correction instructions

*Injuries have reduced the chance of heavier damage by 3 times.
*When injured, sitting down (press INS) can reduce the chance of worsening injury by 6 times.
*When the character is injured, lying down (press CTRL+INS) can reduce the chance of worsening the injury by 30 times.

*When injured, the blood deduction speed is reduced by 3 times while still.
*When the character is injured, sitting down can reduce the blood deduction speed by 6 times.
*When injured, lying down can reduce the blood deduction speed by 30 times.

Other fixes:
＊The reputation gained when fighting monsters has been increased five times.
＊The player side joins the update announcement link.



Thank you for playing my game.

notes.title: Apologies for delayed release date
notes.content:
From the development director, the description of the postponement of the release date is as follows:

The main reason comes from expanding the richness of the achievement system,
We hope that the achievement system can become a historical record of players' wanderings in the world.

From the first character born in the arena, the first friend, the first family member,
To become a good master, a good helper, and even the emperor city master.

All these will be recorded in your achievement system.
And this is the main reason why we postpone the release date.

Apologies,

Director Chao Yi
